subject: Next steps & pilot economics — EdgeAI discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@edgeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery (costs/unit economics)

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and the EdgeAI team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary product: customer support summarization + routing.
- Expected steady-state: ~150–250M tokens/mo (peaks during launches).
- Target pilot: integrate Redwood for a 30-day window to validate latency and quality.

Key questions we need from you
1) Can you confirm your expected monthly active prompt volumes (best guess: tokens per day or month)?
2) What's your target unit cost threshold (e.g., target $/1M tokens) to make Redwood viable vs self-hosting?
3) Any compliance or IP constraints we should know about for the pilot?

Proposed Redwood pilot offer (tentative)
- 30-day pilot with up to 1.5M complimentary tokens to validate integration and sample queries.
- If we see ~200M tokens/mo projection, we can propose a committed pricing band (example: $600–$700 per 1M tokens depending on quantization/throughput profile).

Next steps
- Olivia: share a simple estimate of token volumes and any sample prompts you want us to run. An attached spreadsheet (edgeai_usage_estimate.xlsx) will help.
- Ben: I cc'd Ben for quick pricing validation and to handle credit approvals.
- We can schedule a short follow-up later this week to finalize the credit amount.

Attachment: postcall-summary.pdf (one-page recap)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@edgeai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgeai.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery (costs/unit economics)

Thanks Hannah — really helpful recap. Quick answers below and I've attached a sample prompt file so you can sanity-check token counts.

Token volumes
- Pilot period (30 days): we expect roughly 6–8M tokens (internal test traffic + live shadow traffic).
- Production expectation if all goes well: 180–220M tokens/mo (mostly short summaries, average 25–35 tokens per request).

Target unit economics
- Our internal target is <$650 per 1M tokens (including any platform/service fees) to be competitive against our current self-hosted costs.

Pilot ask
- Could you increase the complimentary token allowance to 2M for the pilot window? That will let us run parallel A/B tests across two product variants.

Compliance
- Nothing unusual: standard DPA required, SOC2 report is required during procurement.

Attachments: pilot_sample_prompts.txt (sample prompts + expected token counts)

Let me know if you need anything else — we can confirm numbers and sign a short mutual action plan.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of Product
EdgeAI
olivia@edgeai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@edgeai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery (costs/unit economics)

Hi Olivia — great data, thanks. Quick response from our side: 

Pricing signal and pilot credit
- Based on the 180–220M tokens/mo profile and your target <$650 per 1M tokens, we can build a committed pricing band in that range. Final price depends on model family and quantization; Hannah and I can run a quick throughput/quality tradeoff and give a concrete $/1M number.
- For the pilot: we're willing to approve a one-time 2,000,000 token credit for the 30-day evaluation (to support the A/B runs you mentioned). This is subject to a short approval from Finance (cc'd: Laura).

Operational asks
- Please upload the sample prompts and a short CSV showing expected daily volume (we'll ingest and run a small load profile).
- Send your SOC2 scope requirements to security@redwood.ai (we'll turn around the report).

Proposed next step
- If Finance approves the credit, we'll send a short MOU (DocuSign) to lock the pilot window and the credit amount. HubSpot deal id: RDW-EDGE-2026-01.

Attachments referenced: edgeai_usage_estimate.xlsx (template)

Laura — can you confirm approval for the 2M pilot credit? If you prefer a smaller amount, happy to propose 1.5M.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery (costs/unit economics)

Ben/Hannah — reviewed the ask. Approved with conditions: 

Approval details
- One-time complimentary credit: 1,500,000 tokens (valid for 30 days from activation).
- Reason: pilot scope looks reasonable and the projected production profile warrants a larger sales motion rather than a freebie.

Conditions
1) Deal must include a follow-up pricing commitment discussion within 14 days after pilot close. Add a clause in the MOU: "pricing review and intent to negotiate commitment".
2) Attach a short attestation from the customer confirming test traffic is non-production (to avoid unlimited abuse).
3) Finance will not backdate credits; activation date must be recorded in our billing ledger and HubSpot.

Action items
- Ben: issue the 1.5M token credit and include Credit Authorization stub (credit-authorization.pdf) in DocuSign envelope.
- Hannah: confirm activation date once EdgeAI is ready and update HubSpot deal RDW-EDGE-2026-01.

I'll approve 2M only after we get the attestation and an explicit product engagement plan.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
